sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह ।संस्कारः क्रियतां भ्रातुः स्त्रियश्चैता निवर्तय ।। ६.११४.९२ ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāmo vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha ।saṁskāraḥ kriyatāṁ bhrātuḥ striyaścaitā nivartaya ।। 6.114.92 ।।

translations.english: While Mandodari was being counselled by the co wives like this, she was weeping, shedding tears on her breast as well as bathing her face. She once again wept making a loud sound.
